item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00261","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C15","C19","C03"],"selected_candidate_label":"C15","confidence":0.99,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C15 is a highly plausible direct drafting template. It predates the child by two months and uses the same distinctive two-part machinery: first excluding specifically described lands from a national monument and withholding the excluded public lands from appropriation until further departmental order, then adding other described lands to the monument subject to valid existing rights, followed by the same warning clause. C19 provides related monument-exclusion, forest-boundary-transfer, and temporary-withdrawal machinery, while C03 is a weaker boundary-redefinition analogue.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"1.
